content.value_statement: Community teams often lack a structured plan for activation, engagement, governance, and measurement. This skill provides practical frameworks for building sustainable member programs.
actual_capabilities: Compares community platforms and recommends selection criteria.
Designs member onboarding flows and activation milestones.
Plans recurring engagement programs, events, and community rituals.
Structures ambassador, champion, and user-generated content programs.
Defines moderation policies, escalation paths, and governance practices.
Selects community health, retention, engagement, and business impact metrics.
limitations: Provides guidance and templates but does not configure community platforms.
Does not access live community data or calculate metrics without supplied inputs.
Recommendations require adaptation to local laws, culture, budget, and platform policies.
Does not replace legal review for privacy, intellectual property, employment, or moderation decisions.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Community
use_cases.description: Choose a platform, define channels, and create an onboarding plan for the first member cohort.

use_cases.title: Build a Developer Program
use_cases.description: Connect technical content, events, feedback loops, and ambassador activities to measurable developer outcomes.

use_cases.title: Improve Community Health
use_cases.description: Review engagement, retention, moderation, and support metrics before prioritizing program changes.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Community Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Discord, Slack, Circle, Discourse, and GitHub Discussions for my community. Use audience, budget, interaction style, moderation, search, and scalability.

prompt_templates.title: Design Member Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 48-hour onboarding flow for [community type]. Define the welcome message, first action, connection opportunity, activation milestone, and follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Engagement Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 90-day engagement calendar for [community]. Include recurring rituals, owners, preparation steps, participation goals, feedback methods, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Community Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this community strategy: [details]. Assess positioning, member journey, governance, content, ambassador design, measurement, risks, and resource requirements. Prioritize improvements.

output_examples.input: Recommend a platform for 300 open-source contributors who need searchable technical discussions.
output_examples.output: Primary recommendation: GitHub Discussions. It supports contributor identity and repository context. Add Discourse when durable documentation and stronger search become priorities.

output_examples.input: Create a first-week onboarding plan for a professional Slack community.
output: Day 0: Welcome members and request a structured introduction.
Day 1: Direct members to one relevant topic channel.
Day 3: Invite participation in office hours.
Day 7: Ask about the first useful connection or answer.

output_examples.input: Suggest a small community health dashboard.
output_examples.output: Track new-member activation, four-week retention, active contributors, unanswered questions, median response time, moderation incidents, and member-reported value.

best_practices: Provide audience, goals, platform, team capacity, budget, and current metrics.
Start with a small set of programs and assign a clear owner to each.
Review quantitative metrics with member feedback before changing strategy.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize member count without measuring activation, retention, and value.
Do not launch many channels or programs before consistent participation exists.
Do not automate sensitive moderation decisions without human review and an appeal path.

faq.question: Can this skill configure Discord or Slack directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance, channel structures, policies, and checklists for a human administrator to implement.

faq.question: Does it support communities outside developer relations?
faq.answer: Yes. The frameworks also apply to customer, professional, creator, course, open-source, and product communities.

faq.question: What information improves platform recommendations?
faq.answer: Share audience characteristics, expected size, communication style, budget, search needs, moderation capacity, integrations, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: Can it measure my live community?
faq.answer: No. Provide exported or summarized data, and the skill can recommend calculations, benchmarks, review cadence, and dashboard structure.

faq.question: Can it create a moderation policy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft rules, escalation levels, team roles, documentation, transparency practices, and appeals. Legal and cultural review remains necessary.

faq.question: How should recommendations be validated?
faq.answer: Test them with a small member cohort, collect qualitative feedback, compare relevant metrics, and revise before broad rollout.
